```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The socialist movement is strengthened when members work consciously against the atomization imposed by capital.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"According to Berenice Fisher and Joan Tronto, care is the labor through which life maintains and thrives.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism undermines care as it seeks to commodify every aspect of human life, including fundamental needs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism grinds health and life to dust to maintain its dominion.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The resulting alienation harms the most vulnerable and undermines the ability to act collectively and secure even modest progressive goals.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As part of the struggle against capitalism, the group rejects all commodified visions of human existence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group advocates for a holistic model of care that emphasizes building and strengthening community ties, cooperation, and solidarity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group values care work within the organization.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group encourages DSA members to see each other as part of a social and political community.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In a democratic mass organization like DSA, there is a collective responsibility to ensure comrades, regardless of social barriers like disability or identity, are given an equal right to participate and be heard without fear of danger to their personal safety or well-being.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When individual actions are imperative, DSA members should mask at meetings, attend to the physical needs of comrades, or directly respond to acts of racism, misogyny, or transphobia from DSA members toward the shared community.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```

```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The socialist movement is strengthened when we work consciously against the atomization imposed by capital.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"According to Berenice Fisher and Joan Tronto, care is “the labor through which life maintains and thrives”.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism undermines care as it seeks to commodify every aspect of human life, including our fundamental needs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism grinds all health and life to dust to maintain its dominion.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The resulting alienation not only harms the most vulnerable, it undermines our ability to act collectively and secure even the most modest progressive goals.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As part and parcel of our struggle against capitalism, we reject all commodified visions of human existence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We advocate for a holistic model of care that emphasizes building and strengthening community ties, cooperation, and solidarity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We especially value care work in our organization.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We encourage DSA members to see each other as part of a social as well as political community.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Our collective responsibility in a democratic mass organization like DSA is to ensure that our comrades, regardless of social barriers like disability or identity, are given an equal right to participate and be heard without fear of danger to their personal safety or well-being.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When our actions as individuals are imperative for doing so, DSA members should mask at meetings, attend to the physical needs of our comrades where necessary, or directly respond to acts of racism, misogyny, or transphobia from DSA members toward our shared community.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
